title: Battle of Honnecourt
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Honnecourt", at revision 1370443189, opens: "The Battle of Honnecourt took place on 26 May 1642, during the 1635 to 1659 Franco-Spanish War. A Spanish army led by Francisco de Melo defeated and largely destroyed a French force under the Comte de Guiche." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1740516, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1642 battle of the Franco-Spanish War of 1635–1659". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
